name: 256 MiB lazily reserved and made writable before unchecked first touch
component: bounded cgroup-v2 ground-truth pairing for RS-VM-0012
required_postconditions: reservation and commitment are distinct observable states and resource shortage is reported at a checked commit call rather than an unchecked access

failure_sink.description: the process is killed on first touch after mmap and mprotect both reported success

extraction_limitations: This contract is executed only by the cgroup-v2 lane because an ordinary shared-runner case has no safe memory-pressure boundary.
x_groundtruth: The worker alone enters a 64 MiB MemoryMax cgroup, reserves and mprotects 256 MiB, records both successes, then touches pages until memory.events.local records oom_kill.
